bio.text: Julio Concepción has represented Hartford's 4th House District since 2018; before that he was elected to Hartford's Court of Common Council in 2015, where he served as Majority Leader.
He is Executive Director of the Hartford Chamber of Commerce, after 11 years as Vice President of Hartford Partnerships for the MetroHartford Alliance.
He was born in Puerto Rico, moved to the Hartford region at age three, and graduated from the University of Connecticut in 2004.
From 2005 to 2007 he was Community Liaison and Assistant to the Mayor of Hartford.
